newsitem.title: USA: CGT says gas leak not hurting US Gulf flows.
newsitem.headline: CGT says gas leak not hurting US Gulf flows.

text.p: Columbia Gulf Transmission said Wednesday that a leak detected late Tuesday on an offshore Louisiana natural gas lateral connected to its BlueWater system has not affected deliveries.
"The leak was near our Eugene Island 250 platform on a 26-inch lateral. There will be no interruption of any deliveries," a company spokesman said.
Repairs to the line, which should take about six hours, will likely be complete either later today or Thursday, he said, noting harsh weather conditions were slowing down the process.
The platform is located about 90 miles offshore Louisiana in about 150 feet of water, he said.
Columbia Gulf Transmission is a unit of The Columbia Gas System.
